description:
At CAE, we equip people in critical roles with the expertise and solutions to create a safer world. As a technology company, we digitalize the physical world, deploying software-based simulation training and critical operations support solutions. Above all else, we empower pilots, cabin crew, airlines, and defence and security forces to perform at their best every day and when the stakes are the highest. Around the globe, we’re everywhere customers need us to be with more than 13,000 employees in approximately 250 sites and training locations in over 40 countries. CAE represents more than 75 years of industry firsts—the highest-fidelity flight and mission simulators as well as training programs powered by digital technologies. We embed sustainability in everything we do. Today and tomorrow, we’ll make sure our customers are ready for the moments that matter. 
 
 The NATO Airborne Early Warning and Control Force (NAEW&CF) at Geilenkirchen (Germany) is seeking qualified (5+ years) E-Learning Developer (f/m/d) to support the redesign and development of technical and procedural e-learning training materials. The incumbent will work on-site within a multi-national environment and daily collaborate with an SME (Subject Matter Expert) to produce instructionally sound, digital learning products. English (C-1 level) will be the sole working language during the project.
 
 This position requires strong technical proficiency in multimedia production tools and e-learning authoring software, as well as the ability to follow established procedures, standards, and development guidelines.
 
 QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE 
 Essential
 · Excellent command of the English language, both written and spoken (C1 level).
 · Ability to work accurately, follow established rules and guidelines, and maintain consistency across multiple training products.
 · Thorough working knowledge of Articulate Storyline, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Animate and PremierePro.
 · Demonstrated experience (portfolio) developing e-learning content using Articulate Storyline (primary tool).
 · Knowledge of instructional design principles and user-experience considerations.
 · Proven ability to transform technical and procedural subject matter into well-structured learning solutions.
 · Experience working in international or multicultural environments.
 Desirable
 · Previous experience supporting training design in technical, aviation, military, or engineering domains.
 
 MAIN DUTIES 
 1. Develop and redesign e-learning modules using Articulate Storyline in accordance with NATO AEW&C Force standards and technical requirements.
 2. Produce and refine graphics, animations, and interactive components using Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Animate.
 3. Interpret technical source material, including operational procedures, to ensure accurate representation within the training products.
 4. Work in close coordination with subject matter experts, instructional designers, and other project personnel.
 5. Ensure technical accuracy and visual consistency across all deliverables.
 6. Adhere to established workflows, including version control, documentation, and quality assurance steps.
 7. Contribute to continuous improvement of digital learning products and production processes.
 
 COMPETENCIES 
 · Effective Communication (English, C1 level)
 · Attention to Detail
 · Teamwork & Cooperation in a Multinational Environment
 · Planning and Organizing
 · Adherence to Standards and Procedures
 · Technical Expertise in Multimedia Production
 
 REMARKS 
 · This is an on-site position; remote work or teleworking is not available.
 · The role supports a time-limited project and involves interaction with operational personnel and technical subject matter experts.
 · Security clearance requirements, if applicable, will be communicated separately.
 · The position is open to candidates legally authorized to work in Germany.
 · A possible job-interview will be in English, in Germany.
 
 
 About CAE 
 At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success. 
        
 Position Type                       
Regular 
 
 Equal Opportunity & Accommodations 
 
 CAE is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, veteran status, age, or other characteristics protected by law. We encourage applicants who may not meet every qualification to apply. Reasonable accommodations are available—contact your recruiter or email CAECarrieres-Careers@cae.com if needed.
